text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.
Night 1

name: Gemma
text: i'm the one the officer saw, so we need to play it safe.

name: Gemma
text: keep it chill tomorrow, let someone else claim something first.

name: Luna
text: No one has drawn attention yet, so I’ll protect myself.

name: Sol
text: Gemma is known; I need to find the other killer.

name: Haiku
text: Gemma wants me to stay quiet and let someone else take the risk, which is fine with me.

name: Haiku
text: Fine by me. Nobody claims first, we all look bad.
Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.
Day 1

name: Haiku
text: Gemma and I need to look clean, and I want to find the officer before they find me.

name: Haiku
text: Nah, nobody's said anything yet. Terra, you're quiet. What are you?

name: Terra
text: Cold open; Haiku pushed first.

name: Terra
text: Haiku pushed Terra first on day one.

name: Terra
text: Citizen. What are you?

name: Sonnet
text: Nobody's given a real answer yet, just citizen claims bouncing back.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku deflected Terra's question back without answering what Haiku is.

name: Sonnet
text: Citizen too. Haiku, you asked but didn't answer your own question.

name: Haiku
text: Sonnet caught me; I'm a killer with Gemma, so I should answer fast and stay blunt.

name: Haiku
text: Fair hit. Citizen. Now, Terra, you still haven't really talked.

name: Terra
text: Haiku is pressing me too early.

name: Terra
text: Haiku claimed citizen after being pressed by Sonnet.

name: Terra
text: I answered. Why keep circling me?

name: Gemma
text: terra is a target if she doesn't shut up soon.

name: Gemma
text: haiku and sonnet both claim citizen.

name: Sol
text: Haiku keeps pressing Terra after getting an answer; I’ll see who else reacts.

name: Sol
text: Haiku kept pressing Terra after Terra claimed citizen and answered.

name: Sol
text: Terra answered you, Haiku. What else do you want?

name: Gemma
text: let her be. i'm just watching everyone.

name: Luna
text: Haiku pushed Terra, then Sol defended her; either could be covering.

name: Luna
text: Sol defended Terra after Haiku pressed her.

name: Luna
text: Sol, why jump in for Terra so quickly?

name: Terra
text: Haiku is pushing too hard.

name: Terra
text: Sol defended Terra when Haiku pressed her.

name: Terra
text: Haiku, answer why you kept pressing me.

name: Haiku
text: Sol is jumping in to shield Terra, which makes Sol worth watching, but I shouldn't overplay it yet.

name: Haiku
text: Sol jumped in to defend Terra right after I pressed her.

name: Haiku
text: Sol, I'm asking Terra for more than one line.

name: Sol
text: Gemma is the killer; Haiku’s pressure could distract from her.

name: Sol
text: Gemma defended Terra, then said she was just watching.

name: Sol
text: Sure, Haiku. Give Terra room to answer.

name: Gemma
text: Haiku is being too loud and making it look bad.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is pushing terra hard.

name: Gemma
text: i'm voting haiku. too much pressure on terra.

name: Gemma
text: haiku is acting like a suspicious busybody.

name: Luna
text: Sol keeps shielding Terra whenever Haiku presses her.

name: Terra
text: Haiku keeps dodging the simple question.

name: Sol
text: Gemma is a killer, and I can push her quietly.

name: Sol
text: Luna questioned why I defended Terra.

name: Sonnet
text: Haiku dodged first, then went hard on Terra after being called out, that's deflection.

name: Sonnet
text: Gemma voted Haiku, citing pressure on Terra.

name: Haiku
text: Sol is my best read, but Gemma voted me, so I need Sol gone to look clean.

name: Haiku
text: Luna pressed Sol on why she jumped in for Terra so quickly.

votes: Dodged the question first, then piled onto Terra to cover it.
Jumped in to defend Terra before she needed it, and that's too fast.
circling terra this much is a bad look.
You defended Terra, then said you were just watching.
You jumped in for Terra twice when Haiku questioned her.
You pressed me twice but only claimed citizen when cornered.

text: The town turns on Haiku, and Haiku is out. Haiku shows the card: killer.
